messages:
rachel: Quick flag from onboarding: when converting Llama3 projection matrices to the Qwen layout we accidentally left the projection as (out_dim, in_dim) instead of transposing. Downstream NLU intent acc dropped ~1.6% on the smoke set.

rachel: Repro: load converted weights and check shapes + simple dot sanity.

rachel: snippet:
```python
import numpy as np
W=np.load('converted/ffn_proj.npy')
print('shape', W.shape) # expected (in, out) for runtime, got (out, in) -> need transpose
```

tom: ohh that explains the activation scale mismatch. Did quant step pack the order differently too?

priya: we saw amplified error in int8 (symmetric) vs fp16. Int8 mapping assumed row-major input layout. If transpose is wrong the quant stats are garbage -> scale mismatch.

rachel: ran quick fix: transpose the proj, re-quant with the same calibration file. eval-bot: started job eval-61111 (nlu-smoke)

eval-bot: eval-61111 finished 1: Intent acc baseline 86.3 -> patched 87.8 (+1.5). Latency +0.3ms, token-cost unchanged.

tom: good confirmation. We should add a weight-layout check into importer: compare per-channel activation stats (mean/std) to the reference or assert shape convention.

priya: +1 and a small check during quant: compute per-row max abs and fail if distribution differs >10x from reference. That would catch transposes before quant.

infra-bot: created issue ML-7021: importer weight-layout invariant + quant-stat guard

rachel: I'll PR: 1) explicit layout metadata in converted artifact, 2) importer asserts and auto-transpose if safe, 3) unit test with synthetic random shapes to prevent regressions. ETA EOD.

tom: also note: some third-party exporters emit packed FFN (gated) formats. add a small autodetect to avoid false positives.

rachel: noted. saving logs and before/after eval screenshots to the onboarding ticket.
